title: Dasakam 10
description: Brahma’s early creation unfolds through the Kumaras, Rudra, the sages, Saraswati, the Vedas, and Manu and Shataroopa.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वैकुण्ठ वर्धितबलोऽथ भवत्प्रसादा-
-दम्भोजयोनिरसृजत् किल जीवदेहान् ।
स्थास्नूनि भूरुहमयानि तथा तिरश्चां
जातीर्मनुष्यनिवहानपि देवभेदान् ॥ १०-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: By Bhagwan’s grace, with increased spiritual powers, Brahma started creating varieties of beings, those that grow on earth, non-moving like trees etc.,&  the moving, like animals birds etc., human beings and various divine beings. These serve as bodies for the jeevas to enter into.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vaikuṇṭha vardhitabalo’tha bhavatprasādā-
-dambhojayonirasṛjat kila jīvadehān |
sthāsnūni bhūruhamayāni tathā tiraścāṃ
jātīrmanuṣyanivahānapi devabhedān || 10-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मिथ्याग्रहास्मिमतिरागविकोपभीति-
-रज्ञानवृत्तिमिति पञ्चविधां स सृष्ट्वा ।
उद्दामतामसपदार्थविधानदून-
-स्तेने त्वदीयचरणस्मरणं विशुद्ध्यै ॥ १०-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma then created the five-fold effects of ignorance, which are wrong apprehension, egoism, attachment, anger and fear. Having created these extremely negative qualities and repenting for doing so, he resorted to meditation to Bhagwan for self purification.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
mithyāgrahāsmimatirāgavikopabhīti-
-rajñānavṛttimiti pañcavidhāṃ sa sṛṣṭvā |
uddāmatāmasapadārthavidhānadūna-
-stene tvadīyacaraṇasmaraṇaṃ viśuddhyai || 10-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावत् ससर्ज मनसा सनकं सनन्दं
भूयः सनातनमुनिं च सनत्कुमारम् ।
ते सृष्टिकर्मणि तु तेन नियुज्यमाना-
-स्त्वत्पादभक्तिरसिका जगृहुर्न वाणीम् ॥ १०-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma then from his mind created Sanaka, Sananda, Sanaatana Muni and Sanat Kumaras. Even though they were directed by Brahma to engage in the work of creation, they did not heed his words because they were highly devoted to Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvat sasarja manasā sanakaṃ sanandaṃ
bhūyaḥ sanātanamuniṃ ca sanatkumāram |
te sṛṣṭikarmaṇi tu tena niyujyamānā-
-stvatpādabhaktirasikā jagṛhurna vāṇīm || 10-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावत् प्रकोपमुदितं प्रतिरुन्धतोऽस्य
भ्रूमध्यतोऽजनि मृडो भवदेकदेशः ।
नामानि मे कुरु पदानि च हा विरिञ्चे-
-त्यादौ रुरोद किल तेन स रुद्रनामा ॥ १०-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: This made Brahma angry which he tried to control. That caused the birth of Mrida from between his eyebrows. Mrida at once cried out and told Brahma to provide him with names and abodes. Thus Mrida came to be known as Rudra.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvat prakopamuditaṃ pratirundhato’sya
bhrūmadhyato’jani mṛḍo bhavadekadeśaḥ |
nāmāni me kuru padāni ca hā viriñce-
-tyādau ruroda kila tena sa rudranāmā || 10-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
एकादशाह्वयतया च विभिन्नरूपं
रुद्रं विधाय दयिता वनिताश्च दत्त्वा ।
तावन्त्यदत्त च पदानि भवत्प्रणुन्नः
प्राह प्रजाविरचनाय च सादरं तम् ॥ १०-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma then prompted by Bhagwan, gave Rudra eleven names, forms, abodes and as many wives and humbly requested him to help in the creative process.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ekādaśāhvayatayā ca vibhinnarūpaṃ
rudraṃ vidhāya dayitā vanitāśca dattvā |
tāvantyadatta ca padāni bhavatpraṇunnaḥ
prāha prajāviracanāya ca sādaraṃ tam || 10-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
रुद्राभिसृष्टभयदाकृतिरुद्रसङ्घ-
-सम्पूर्यमाणभुवनत्रयभीतचेताः ।
मा मा प्रजाः सृज तपश्चर मङ्गलाये-
-त्याचष्ट तं कमलभूर्भवदीरितात्मा ॥ १०-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rudra’s creation consisted of fierce looking Rudras, which were filling up the three worlds. Brahma was frightened by them, and being prompted by Bhagwan, told Rudra not to create any more beings, and asked him to do penance for the benefit of the world.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
rudrābhisṛṣṭabhayadākṛtirudrasaṅgha-
-sampūryamāṇabhuvanatrayabhītacetāḥ |
mā mā prajāḥ sṛja tapaścara maṅgalāye-
-tyācaṣṭa taṃ kamalabhūrbhavadīritātmā || 10-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तस्याथ सर्गरसिकस्य मरीचिरत्रि-
-स्तत्राङ्गिराः क्रतुमुनिः पुलहः पुलस्त्यः ।
अङ्गादजायत भृगुश्च वसिष्ठदक्षौ
श्रीनारदश्च भगवन् भवदङ्घ्रिदासः ॥ १०-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma, who was intent on creation, from his own body created (the sages) Mareechi, Atri, Angiraas, Kratumuni, Pulaha, Pulastya, Bhrigu, Vasishtha, the Dakshas and also Shri Naarada, who is a devotee of Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tasyātha sargarasikasya marīciratri-
-statrāṅgirāḥ kratumuniḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ |
aṅgādajāyata bhṛguśca vasiṣṭhadakṣau
śrīnāradaśca bhagavan bhavadaṅghridāsaḥ || 10-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
धर्मादिकानभिसृजन्नथ कर्दमं च
वाणीं विधाय विधिरङ्गजसङ्कुलोऽभूत् ।
त्वद्बोधितैः सनकदक्षमुखैस्तनूजै-
-रुद्बोधितश्च विरराम तमो विमुञ्चन् ॥ १०-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma further created Dharmadeva, sage Kardama and then Saraswati. He was then overcome with desire for her, his own creation. However, prompted by Bhagwan, Sanaka Daksha and his other sons enlightened him and he gave up desire, being disillusioned.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dharmādikānabhisṛjannatha kardamaṃ ca
vāṇīṃ vidhāya vidhiraṅgajasaṅkulo’bhūt |
tvadbodhitaiḥ sanakadakṣamukhaistanūjai-
-rudbodhitaśca virarāma tamo vimuñcan || 10-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
वेदान् पुराणनिवहानपि सर्वविद्याः
कुर्वन् निजाननगणाच्चतुराननोऽसौ ।
पुत्रेषु तेषु विनिधाय स सर्गवृद्धि-
-मप्राप्नुवंस्तव पदाम्बुजमाश्रितोऽभूत् ॥ १०-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma then brought out the Vedas and all the Puraanas and all the other branches of learning, from his four faces and taught them to his sons. He then found himself unable to further the process of creation and so he took refuge at Bhagwan’s lotus feet.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vedān purāṇanivahānapi sarvavidyāḥ
kurvan nijānanagaṇāccaturānano’sau |
putreṣu teṣu vinidhāya sa sargavṛddhi-
-maprāpnuvaṃstava padāmbujamāśrito’bhūt || 10-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जानन्नुपायमथ देहमजो विभज्य
स्त्रीपुंसभावमभजन्मनुतद्वधूभ्याम् ।
ताभ्यां च मानुषकुलानि विवर्धयंस्त्वं
गोविन्द मारुतपुरेश निरुन्धि रोगान् ॥ १०-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Then prompted by Bhagwan and knowing the technique, Brahma, from the two sides of his body created the male and the female, named Manu and his wife Shataroopa. Through them he then multiplied the human race.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jānannupāyamatha dehamajo vibhajya
strīpuṃsabhāvamabhajanmanutadvadhūbhyām |
tābhyāṃ ca mānuṣakulāni vivardhayaṃstvaṃ
govinda mārutapureśa nirundhi rogān || 10-10 ||
